title: Refugee Liberation
description: With evidence of the connection between the mines and Compound 7-Alpha, the refugees are in even greater danger. The syndicate knows they're talking, and they won't hesitate to silence them. Lira Tann, the refugee leader, needs help getting her people to safety. Help them secure transport, supplies, and protection to escape Sytha and find a new home.
shortDescription: Help the refugees escape Sytha and find safety

objectives.description: Speak with Lira Tann about the refugees' situation
Secure transport for the refugees (negotiate with smugglers or Concord)
Gather supplies for the refugees (rations, medpacs, credits)
Defeat syndicate thugs attacking the refugee camp
Successfully evacuate the refugees from Sytha
